ESP.note: Spain is the world's #1 fresh-orange exporter (HS 080510); FAOSTAT/UN Comtrade 2024 orange exports ~2.9 Mt, mostly intra-EU. Also leads EU mandarin (080521) exports.

ZAF.note: South Africa is the largest Southern-Hemisphere citrus exporter; 2024 orange exports ~1.45 Mt (counter-seasonal to the EU). Strong in soft citrus and lemons (080550).

EGY.note: Egypt vies with Spain as the top global fresh-orange exporter by volume; 2024 orange exports ~1.7 Mt to Russia, the Gulf and Asia (HS 080510).

USA.note: US citrus output hit by HLB (greening) disease and hurricanes; a net fresh-citrus importer. 2024 orange exports ~0.55 Mt (Asia); imports from Mexico/Chile/South Africa.

TUR.note: Turkiye 2024 orange exports ~0.7 Mt to Russia, Iraq, Ukraine, the Gulf (HS 080510); also a major mandarin/lemon exporter.

MAR.note: Morocco 2024 citrus exports ~0.6 Mt — soft citrus (mandarins) plus oranges — to Russia, the EU and North America.

GRC.note: Greece 2024 orange exports ~0.42 Mt within the EU and to the Balkans/Eastern Europe (HS 080510).

ARG.note: Argentina 2024 citrus exports ~0.32 Mt; world-leading in lemons (080550) plus oranges to the EU/Russia.

MEX.note: Mexico is a top orange producer; 2024 fresh exports ~0.45 Mt, mostly to the US (limes 080550 and oranges).

DEU.note: Germany is among the largest fresh-orange importers; 2024 gross imports ~1.2 Mt (HS 080510), a large re-export hub for the rest of the EU.

NLD.note: Netherlands is Europe's citrus re-export gateway (Rotterdam); 2024 imports ~0.95 Mt with most re-exported across the EU (HS 080510).

FRA.note: France 2024 orange imports ~0.8 Mt (HS 080510), mainly from Spain, with re-exports onward.

RUS.note: Russia is the top single-country fresh-orange import market; 2024 imports ~0.7 Mt led by Egypt, Turkiye, South Africa, Morocco (HS 080510).

CHN.note: China is the largest citrus producer; small relative to output, 2024 fresh-orange imports ~0.35 Mt (South Africa, Australia, Egypt) and mandarin exports to Asia.

GBR.note: UK 2024 fresh-orange imports ~0.42 Mt (HS 080510), mainly from Spain, South Africa, Egypt.

SAU.note: Saudi Arabia 2024 orange imports ~0.38 Mt (HS 080510) from Egypt, South Africa, Turkiye.

AUS.note: Australia 2024 orange exports ~0.28 Mt to Asia (China, Japan, SE Asia); counter-seasonal Navel supply.

rankings.note: Citrus (oranges focus, HS 080510). Exporter and importer figures are FAOSTAT / UN Comtrade 2024 published aggregates; per-flow tonnages are FAO/Comtrade-published estimates (flagged modeled) rather than fresh per-flow customs pulls. Spain, Egypt and South Africa supply the bulk of traded fresh oranges; Germany, Netherlands, France lead imports (heavy EU re-export).

companies.name: Wonderful Citrus
companies.metric: Largest US fresh-citrus grower-packer-shipper (part of The Wonderful Company)
companies.note: Wonderful Halos mandarins, oranges, lemons; vertically integrated California/Texas citrus plus Mexico limes.
companies.improve: Should disclose farm-level water-use and HLB-resistance investment to signal supply resilience.

companies.name: Capespan
companies.metric: Major Southern-Hemisphere citrus exporter and global fresh-produce marketer
companies.note: Key counter-seasonal citrus supplier to the EU and Asia (oranges, soft citrus, lemons).
companies.improve: Should publish per-corridor volume and cold-chain loss data to make export reliability auditable.

companies.name: Mehadrin
companies.metric: Israel's largest grower-exporter of citrus (Jaffa brand)
companies.note: Owner of the historic Jaffa orange brand; significant EU and Asia presence in easy-peelers and lemons.
companies.improve: Should report water-efficiency and drought-contingency metrics given arid-region production risk.

companies.name: Greenyard
companies.metric: One of the largest global fresh-produce distributors
companies.note: Supplies European retail; major citrus volumes (Spanish/South African/Egyptian) move through its network.
companies.improve: Should increase origin-level traceability disclosure so single-origin dependency (e.g. Spain) is visible to buyers.

companies.name: Dole plc
companies.metric: Revenue ~US$8bn (FY2024); one of the world's largest fresh-produce companies
companies.note: Formed from Dole and Total Produce; broad citrus distribution across the Americas and EMEA.
companies.improve: Should break out citrus-specific volumes and supplier concentration in sustainability reporting.

companies.name: Citrosol
companies.metric: Leading post-harvest treatment/coatings supplier for citrus packers
companies.note: Underpins Spanish citrus export shelf-life and quality (post-harvest infrastructure, not a grower).
companies.improve: Should quantify residue-reduction and waste-loss outcomes to evidence food-loss impact across the citrus chain.

global.note: Global citrus, oranges-focused (HS 080510), kt. Production/consumption are total fresh oranges (FAOSTAT); exports are world fresh-orange export volume. Total all-citrus (incl. mandarins 080521, lemons/limes 080550, grapefruit) production is roughly 2.5x these orange-only figures (~160-165 Mt/yr).
